channel.title: North Bay Nugget - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from North Bay Nugget (nugget.ca)

item.title: School bus company and drivers $1.10 per hour away from making a deal
item.description: Alouette Bus Lines offering raise to $20 per hour, but union demands a 'living wage' of $21.10, which is far less than other drivers make.

item.title: Fednor kicks in cash to try to encourage companies to look at defence sector opportunities
item.description: Government of Canada invests $472,859 to help Northern Ontario businesses diversify into the defence industry

item.title: Mark King and Chris Mayne turn up the heat over Cassellholme board removal
item.description: North Bay city councillors Mark King and Chris Mayne expressed frustration over their removal from the Cassellholme board and King wants the board investigated by the province

item.title: Callander launches overnight parking pilot project for ice fishers
item.description: Two municipal parking lots near the lake will now allow fishers to leave their vehicles there overnight.

item.title: The headliner for the 2026 'Bay Block Party' has been selected
item.description: The headliner has been announced and this year's Bay Block Party and there will also be a pre-party on the Friday night before the big show

item.title: North Bay Battalion need to take advantage of this week's schedule with two of three at home
item.description: North Bay getting more home dates now after a road trip last weekend. They still won two of three away from Boart Longyear Memorial Gardens.

item.title: North Bay Police Service seizes $23k in Fentanyl, woman from Greater Toronto Area arrested
item.description: The suspect was wanted on an outstanding warrant and that played a key role in her arrest by the North Bay Police Service

item.title: Brian Barrer’s new exhibit 'Where We Gather' comes to Callander
item.description: ‘Art slows us down long enough to see differently,’ Barrer remarked
